text: Coffee with Simone and Lola. Simone's birthday is next Saturday and she's been going on about a new pair of climbing shoes, size 39. Lola's off to Lisbon on Thursday for a week. Remind me to text Lola the day before to ask if she wants a lift to the airport.
Jack's really into his Warhammer now, painting a whole Ultramarines army. He said the new paint set is too pricey for him. Could be a good one for his birthday in a fortnight.
Errands: post office before it shuts Friday, pick up dry cleaning, renew car insurance by the 30th.

Rang Wei tonight. Her dad's 70th is this weekend and she's doing the whole cake herself, three tiers, bit stressed about it. Her brother Reza is flying in from Toronto on Friday. Should check in with her on Sunday to see how the party went.
Emil's band has a gig at the Lexington next Tuesday. He's nervous because it's their first one with the new drummer. Don't forget to send him good luck that afternoon.

Bumped into Gemma at the market. Her daughter turns six on Wednesday and is obsessed with Bluey, everything has to be Bluey. Gemma's throwing a small party the Saturday after. I'm bringing the balloons.
Jun's started knitting, mostly socks so far. Says it's the only thing that switches her brain off after work. Uses chunky merino and hates acrylic.
Astrid said the book club's Friday meetup is called off, half of them have flu. Next one probably in a fortnight. She's reading the new Sally Rooney and not loving it.

Long chat with Shanice. She's gutted, Arsenal lost again and she had money on it. Her partner Malik got season tickets for her birthday last year, so the bar's high this time. Her birthday's on the 14th. She mentioned wanting a signed shirt but that's way out of budget. Maybe a framed print of the Emirates? Must ask Malik what he's getting her so we don't double up.
Sadia's mum is in hospital for her knee op tomorrow. Sadia's taking the morning off to drive her in. Need to message Sadia the next day and see how it went.
Antoine and his wife are celebrating their tenth anniversary Friday, dinner at the place by the canal. Their kids are staying with his sister.
Milan is training for the Brighton half in April, running four times a week. Knee's been playing up though.
Bao's dog Pepper had her operation on Monday and is wearing the cone of shame. Bao's been sleeping on the sofa next to her. Remind me to ask Bao how Pepper's doing at the weekend.
Haircut tomorrow at 10. Then gym, then batch cook for the week.
Noah got into the county chess squad! Tournament in Leeds next month. His dad Carlos is driving him up the night before. I should send Noah a congrats message.
Zara mentioned she collects vinyl, mostly 70s soul and old Motown pressings. Her birthday's Thursday. Record shop on the high street has a Marvin Gaye first pressing, worth a look.

Caught up with Eva and Olivia over brunch. Eva's moving to Bristol at the end of the month, she's sad to leave but the job's too good. Olivia's helping her pack on Saturday. Eva wants a leaving do the Friday before but hasn't sorted a venue.
Sam's doing his driving test on Wednesday morning, third attempt. He's properly anxious. Text him good luck Tuesday night and then ask how it went that afternoon.
Aaliyah is mad into Formula 1, Ferrari fan since she was a kid. Her brother Hamza thinks it's hilarious. She'd love the Ferrari team cap, keep that in mind for Christmas.
Catalina's wedding is off. She and Andre split last week. She's staying at her sister's for now and doesn't want to talk about it much. Need to check in with her in a few days, no pressure.
Nasser's started cello lessons at 41 and is loving it. Practises every morning before work. His teacher says he could do grade 3 next summer.
Mai's son starts nursery on Monday. She's more nervous than he is. Her husband's doing drop off that first morning because she has a meeting.
Book dentist. Return the Amazon parcel. Buy stamps.
Naledi's housewarming is Saturday from 7. She's vegan so I'll bring the mushroom thing. Her flatmate Aisha is gluten free too apparently.
Malik's been laid off, found out yesterday. He's putting a brave face on but you can tell he's rattled. His wife's due in March so the timing is awful. Must call him this weekend.
Hamza said his gran's 90th is next Sunday, whole family going to Birmingham for lunch. He's doing a slideshow of old photos.
Alfie's into retro gaming, has every Game Boy ever made apparently. Wants a Game Boy Color in the clear purple. Birthday in three weeks. Don't forget to check eBay.
Simone said Lola's interview went brilliantly yesterday and they've already offered her the job! Starts in January. Need to send Lola a congrats card.
Jack and his partner Gemma are expecting! Due in May. They're both buzzing. Gemma's had awful morning sickness though.
Saw Wei at the climbing wall. She's moving up to the 6b routes now. Wants to do an outdoor trip to Fontainebleau next spring.
Quick one: Reza's exam results come out Thursday. Ask him how he did on Friday.
Emil's grandma passed away on Sunday. Funeral's next Friday in Gdansk, he's flying out Wednesday. I'll mind his cat Biscuit while he's gone. Should send flowers to his mum before the funeral.
Jun and her husband are off to Japan for three weeks from Tuesday, first proper holiday since the baby. Her mum's coming with them to help.
Astrid is a massive Tolkien nerd, reads the whole trilogy every winter. Has a first edition Hobbit she won't let anyone touch. Hates the films.
Need to sort the car MOT this week. Also ring the council about the bins, they skipped us again.
Shanice told me her nan's turning 85 on the 2nd. They're doing afternoon tea at the Savoy the day after. She asked if I'd chip in for flowers, said yes.
Sadia had a scan on Tuesday, all fine. She'd been worrying for weeks but it's all clear now. Her husband took her out for dinner that evening to celebrate.
Antoine is obsessed with sourdough, has a starter called Gerald he feeds twice a day. Brought me a loaf, it was incredible.

Milan's sister Zara is getting married in June, the hen do is in Ibiza the weekend before. Milan's not invited obviously but he's organising the stag for her fiance Carlos. Big pressure, he's been stressing about it all week. Remind me to ask Milan on Monday if he's booked the paintball.

Lunch with Bao, Noah and Eva. Bao's just finished his MA, graduation's on the 18th. Noah's got a new puppy, a cockapoo called Rolo, and is completely sleep deprived. Eva's training for a triathlon in a fortnight and is swimming every morning. Nice to see them all.
Olivia's play opens next Thursday, she's got the lead. Opening night jitters already. I've got tickets for the Saturday. Should send her a good luck text the day before.
Sam said Aaliyah is applying to the Royal College of Music, audition is on the 12th. She plays violin, been at it since she was four. She's pretty calm about it apparently.
Andre's dad has started chemo. Andre's going down to see him every weekend. He's exhausted.
Weekend plan: Saturday clear out the shed, Sunday farmers market and then finally finish the jigsaw.
Catalina loves board games, especially the long strategy ones like Twilight Imperium. Her birthday's next Friday. She dropped a hint about the new expansion.
Talked to Nasser on the phone. His daughter Mai has her GCSE mocks the week after half term and he's worried she's not revising. He's coaching her five a side team on Saturdays too.
Naledi and Aisha are doing a pottery course on Wednesday nights. Aisha made a wonky mug she's weirdly proud of.
Malik's wife had the baby! Little girl, Amira, born Saturday morning. Remind me to drop off a meal for them next week and get a card.
Hamza's leaving drinks are Friday at the Crown, he's off to a new job in Manchester. Starts the Monday after. I should ask him how the first week went.
Alfie's mum is having her hip done next Tuesday. He's taking the week off to look after her. Check in with him midweek.
Simone plays bass in a ska band, gigs every couple of months. Next one's at the Dublin Castle on Saturday. Her boyfriend Jack does the sound.
Gemma's Uncle Reza is retiring after thirty years at the post office. Party is next Saturday. She's making a photo book. Must give her the photos from the summer before Thursday.
Pick up prescription, sort out the gas bill and get Mum's present wrapped before Sunday.
Wei mentioned her son Jun is into Pokémon cards in a big way, trading at school every lunchtime. His birthday's on the 3rd. Booster box could work.
Lola said Astrid failed her theory test again yesterday, she's really down about it. Retake is in a fortnight. Remind me to message Astrid tomorrow to see how she's doing.

Dinner with Shanice and her sister Olivia. Olivia's just got engaged to her girlfriend, they're planning a small wedding next autumn. Shanice is already planning the hen. Their parents are thrilled. Olivia's also in the middle of buying a flat in Leith, completion should be in a fortnight. Need to send Olivia congrats and maybe something for the new flat.
Emil's gone vegetarian, says it's for the climate. Still eats fish though so not sure what that makes him.
Bao's cat Mochi went missing on Sunday night. Posters up all over the estate. He's beside himself.
Antoine's birthday on Friday. He's getting into fly fishing, wants new waders. Lola and I are going halves. Need to order them by Tuesday so they arrive in time.
Train tickets for Christmas go on sale tomorrow morning. Set an alarm.
